question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(4\operatorname{arsech}⁡(-3x)) \\  & =4\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡(-3x)) \\  & =-4\cdot \frac{1}{(-3x)\sqrt{1-(-3x)^{2}}}\cdot (-3x)^{′} \\  & =-4\cdot \frac{1}{(-3x)\sqrt{1-9{x}^{2}}}\cdot (-3) \\  & =-\frac{4}{x\sqrt{1-9{x}^{2}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
